text:
mira-design: quick prototype link: https://figma.com/file/z/rail-reorg-alt. Proposal: three clusters instead of flat list: Workflows | Deploy | Metrics. trying to reduce cognitive load and make deep links more discoverable. quick thoughts? :eyes:
josh-ux: i like cluster approach. UX Q: if a deep link targets a nested view (eg. /ws/:ws/workflows/:id?panel=history) should we route to the nested URL directly or load parent first then reveal nested panel? what feels least surprising for back-button behavior?
emma-frontend: prefer canonical nested URLs (bookmarkable). client behavior: on load expand parent cluster, scroll the target into view, then focus the panel heading. Implementation sketch:
```
/workspaces/:ws/workflows/:workflowId
/workspaces/:ws/deploy/:envId/instances/:instId
/workspaces/:ws/metrics/summary
```
and support optional query like ?panel=history. keep expand without animation on initial load to avoid scroll jumps.
pranav-pm: copy nits: let's be consistent with labels. use "Workflows" not "Pipelines" in nav and docs. breadcrumbs should read "Acme · Workflows · Build-and-Test" not raw param names. also can we add a tiny share icon on rows for permalink copying? reduces support questions.
lucy-a11y: accessibility checklist: 1) when cluster is opened programmatically announce via aria-live polite: e.g., "Workflows expanded, 3 items". 2) cluster headers need role=button + aria-expanded. 3) when deep link opens a nested panel move keyboard focus to the panel heading (tabindex=-1 + focus()). 4) permalink icon must have aria-label="Copy workflow link" and be keyboard focusable; ensure 24x24 hit target and visible focus ring.
emma-frontend: on navigation we should push history state so back restores list scroll + expand state. sketch: history.pushState({scrollY: window.scrollY, openCluster: 'workflows', panel: 'history'}, '', href); on popstate restore scroll and expanded cluster. need to guard for direct loads (no popstate state).
josh-ux: also consider deep-link landing animation? users expect instant landing; animation sometimes hides focus. recommend no animation for direct-link landing, maybe subtle reveal for in-app transitions only.
pranav-pm: permalink tooltip text should be "Copy workflow link" (not just "Copy link"). small ask from PMs.
lucy-a11y: also ensure the chevron button titles are descriptive: "Expand Workflows" / "Collapse Workflows". screen readers get less confusion.
deploybot: route-checker: failing tests -> history-restore.test.js for /workspaces/:ws/workflows sequence. CI #4621.
mira-design: action items: 1) emma to open PR adding history-state + tests. 2) lucy to write the a11y acceptance criteria snippet we can paste into PR. 3) design to update Figma copy to "Workflows" and add share icon tooltip. 4) QA to add back-button scroll recovery test. I'll file GH issues and link. thanks! :sparkles:
